hook: Kickresume charges you ninety six dollars a year to build your resume. This app does it for free.

features.intro: Build your resume right on the page.
features.say: Type on the left and watch it update live.
Switch templates in one click, even ones built to pass hiring software.

install_line: It runs in any browser. Just make a free account.
caption:
Kickresume charges $96/year. Reactive Resume builds your resume as a PDF for free 📄

✅ Type on the left, watch your resume update live
✅ Switch templates in one click, including ATS-friendly ones
✅ Download a PDF or Word file, or share a public link
✅ No subscription, no tracking, no ads, 100% free

💻 Any browser
ℹ️ You need a free account to save your resume. The optional AI features use your own AI provider, which may have its own costs.

Comment "RESUME" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
